overall: The AG found a violation because the committee failed to identify the bargaining unit and specific purpose before entering executive session, but found no violation on the unlisted topic or the missing 'open session' notice topic; it ordered future compliance and release of the minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Dec. 30, 2015 meeting notice failed to list an anticipated executive session topic, the Tentative Agreement, which was then discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Although it was not listed on the notice, the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing and approving the Tentative Agreement that evening because negotiations with the Greenfield Education Association had concluded just hours before the meeting, and therefore the Committee chair did not reasonably anticipate discussing this topic at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.

allegations.summary: The executive session announcement before convening did not identify the bargaining unit or the specific purpose (the Tentative Agreement), which the AG found was required.
allegations.key_passage: However, the Committee should have identified the name of the collective bargaining unit and the specific purpose for the closed door discussion—the Tentative Agreement—in the announcement prior to convening in executive session, as Attorney Smith has conceded that disclosure of this information would not have compromised the purpose for the closed door discussion.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice failed to list 'open session' as a topic before the executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Although the Committee did not use "open session" as the topic notifying the public that the executive session would be preceded by an open session

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
we order the Committee to release its December 30, 2015 executive session minutes, within 30 days of receipt of this determination, in accordance with the guidance above.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law. In addition, we order the Committee to release its December 30, 2015 executive session minutes, within 30 days of receipt of this determination, in accordance with the guidance above.
